name: Cocopaddle
blurb: Sails a coconut half across the whole archipelago.

name: Mirage Moon
blurb: Shines over the dunes and makes the camels blink.

name: Bill Brolly
blurb: Carries a giant leaf for an umbrella and shares it with the nearest frog.

name: Mossback Monitor
blurb: A pocket-sized monitor lizard, polished by a hundred jungle naps.

name: Lotus Perch
blurb: A pink lotus where the jade dragon-fly naps, humming with its wingbeat.

name: Sandlit Scarab Charm
blurb: A cart-sized beetle shrunk to a charm, its red jewel still blinking.

name: Boulder Jaguar
blurb: A chibi jaguar curled on its mossy boulder, guarding the twisty path with a very serious purr.

name: Moonlit Keg
blurb: A keg on the tide ledge that hides a moonbeam and sneaks it past the coast guard.

name: Nightcap Fox
blurb: A cosy little fox curled up by the camp, who wraps its tail around the warmest spot of the night.

name: Garland Florist
blurb: A little marigold in a pink hat who rows through the lake market and sells garlands to every passing boat.

name: Pepper Prince
blurb: A plump red chili in a tiny crown, who sells the spiciest bargains in the whole market.

name: Teatime Hedgehog
blurb: A round little hedgehog who trots between the tables with a tiny treat and never spills a drop.

name: Headband Pourer
blurb: A calm host in a striped headband who pours three cups and spills not a drop.

name: Frowny Silverback
blurb: A huge, soft-hearted silverback who looks stern but shares his fruit, one at a time.

name: Whiskerwatch Diver
blurb: A bearded diver on the raft who holds a pearl up to the sun and keeps the rest for later.

name: Blinkseed Stonehead
blurb: A carved head in a small red cap who blinks once and drops a gold seed for every question.

name: Pinstripe Plodder
blurb: A chibi zebra with bold black stripes, plodding happily along with the herd and never falling behind.

name: Purplehat Haggler
blurb: A chibi travelling gnome in a purple cone hat, swapping seeds with a dozen lands at once.

name: Whisker Sentinel
blurb: A chibi shrine cat with a red collar, sitting very still beside the path and watching every climber.
